text: 亨通光电公告，公司拟向不超过35名特定投资者发行A股股票，发行数量不超过7.4亿股，募集资金总额不超过人民币66.36亿元。
text_en: Hengtong Optic-Electric announced that the company plans to issue A-share stocks to no more than 35 specific investors, with the number of shares issued not exceeding 740 million shares, and the total amount of funds raised not exceeding RMB 6.636 billion.
